177:t_1:489.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you. Now then, allow me to properly introduce the members of $$フラタニティ$$.」

177:t_1:490.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, yes! Let's start with $$ノノ$$...」

177:t_1:492.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm $$ニコラス・バセロン$$. Please call me $$ニコラ$$.」

177:t_1:493.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I'm $$カシオ・タカシロウ$$. Leave the maintenance of the $$バスターマシン$$s to me.」

177:t_1:494.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$チコ・サイエンス$$. Nice to meet you.」

177:t_1:495.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$.」

177:t_1:496.en:
$$チコ$$
「Introduce yourself properly, $$姫$$. Tell them you're the ace with the number-one kill score among all the $$トップレス$$.」

177:t_1:497.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Forget it, I don't want to talk about that.」

177:t_1:498.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Wow, Big Sis! I knew it, you really are the strongest and the best!」

177:t_1:499.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I said forget it. Just hurry up and introduce yourself.」

177:t_1:500.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm $$ノノ$$! I'll be in your care starting today!」

177:t_1:501.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Single and in full bloom! A maiden with dreams! I'm still only an apprentice in $$フラタニティ$$, but I'll do my best with hard work and guts!」

177:t_1:505.en:
$$チコ$$
「She's an android, you see. So she may be a little different from us.」

177:t_1:507.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Heh heh... I'm embarrassed to admit it.」

177:t_1:508.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I can't believe it. Her soft-looking skin and its sheen are no different from a human's, though.」

177:t_1:509.en:
$$ノノ$$
「P-please don't stare too much. You'll make me blush...」

177:t_1:510.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't know how it is over here, but in our world even androids are granted a reasonable set of rights.」

177:t_1:511.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't allow anyone to lay a hand on this girl.」

177:t_1:512.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis...! You helped $$ノノ$$, didn't you!」

177:t_1:513.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It's just that I hate the leering stares of lecherous men.」

177:t_1:514.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's our $$姫$$. You were an ace, so men all over the world had their eyes on you.」

177:t_1:516.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Looks like you've gathered quite a distinctive group.」

177:t_1:517.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We're what you'd call the strongest team! We're $$フラタニティ$$, bound together by strong ties!」

177:t_1:518.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$ is only an apprentice, though.」

177:t_1:520.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So now we're part of your group as well. We look forward to working with you.」

177:t_1:521.en:
$$カレン$$
「Can I ask one thing? The robots you all use are called Buster Machines too, right?」

177:t_1:522.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You too want to ask about the connection between us and that $$ガンバスター$$, I take it.」

177:t_1:524.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I've already heard about it. You may be disappointed, but it seems to have nothing to do with us.」

177:t_1:525.en:
$$カシオ$$
「From what I've heard, that $$ガンバスター$$ looks like it was built with a different line of technology from our $$バスターマシン$$s.」

177:t_1:526.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But there's one person who's dying to know about its pilot, Miss $$ノリコ$$.」

177:t_1:527.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because! Her name is similar to $$ノノリリ$$'s!」

177:t_1:529.en:
$$ノノ$$
「She's $$ノノ$$'s idol, a space pilot. She's so beautiful, so wonderful, so strong...」

177:t_1:530.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And on top of that, I hear she had an amazing figure.」

177:t_1:531.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm sorry to crush your dream, but the $$ノリコ$$ we know doesn't have what you'd call an amazing figure...」

177:t_1:533.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A-anyway...! You ought to meet $$ノリコ$$ once.」

177:t_1:535.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Unfortunately, we don't know where she is either.」

177:t_1:536.en:
$$カレン$$
「But knowing her, she's bound to be fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ somewhere.」

177:t_1:537.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Understood. Looking forward to the day I meet $$ノリコ$$, $$ノノ$$ will do her best to live on.」

177:t_1:538.en:
$$ニコラ$$
($$蒼の地球$$... the $$新地球皇国$$... the $$サイデリアル$$...)

177:t_1:539.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(I'll wing it on that front. But if I'm in this unit, I'll also get information on the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$バスターマシン$$ of the parallel worlds...)

177:t_1:541.en:
$n
「...The power to fight the $$サイデリアル$$ is gathering.」

177:t_1:542.en:
$$スズネ$$
「With this much power, we could surely even take $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

177:t_1:543.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Now that's fighting spirit. This looks promising.」

177:t_1:545.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm the wandering repairman of $$ビーター・サービス$$, $$ランド・トラビス$$. My nickname, $$ザ・ヒート$$, might be better known, though.」

177:t_1:546.en:
$$ランド$$
「To you, I might do better to call myself the Reactor of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$.」

177:t_1:547.en:
$n
「...He's a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ too...」

177:t_1:548.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've heard about you from $$アルト$$ and the others. You're... the Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, I hear.」

177:t_1:550.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... we're fellow Reactors. Though I kind of knew the moment we met.」

177:t_1:551.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm counting on you from here on, $n!」

177:t_1:554.en:
$$メール$$
「Ahaha, looks like Darling's Heat Smile shot her straight through the heart.」

177:t_1:556.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm $$メール・ビーター$$. I handle sales and accounting for $$ビーター・サービス$$...」

177:t_1:559.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh, I'm used to people calling us 'Beauty and the Beast'.」

177:t_1:561.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's a long story, so I'll explain it as we go.」

177:t_1:562.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... you're the man $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ took an interest in. I've got high hopes for you, $n.」

177:t_1:563.en:
$n
「So you fought alongside $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ on the $$翠の地球$$ too, $$ランド$$...」

177:t_1:564.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've heard about him. Who'd have thought he'd go and die...」

177:t_1:566.en:
$$ランド$$
「He said it, you know. That you would save us.」

177:t_1:567.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ staked his life to save me. I want to answer that.」

177:t_1:568.en:
$n
「No... not only $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I want to fight for all the people who lent me strength to keep living.」
